d:
I was initially going to upload each set with their own unique galleries, but I figured it would be inconvenient both for downloaders and for the Terms of Service(since it says to avoid posting galleries with only a few images). I've seen plenty of non-expunged galleries uploaded with this philosophy in mind so I doubt it counts as a "compilation" either(I think only one of those CG sets have been uploaded here before, and not with this quality iirc. Everything else is new). This is in release order afaik. I hope you guys enjoy it.

As always, please support the artist if you have any change to spare and like his art. Numahana in particular needs it because i reckon this motherfucker was borderline starving a few years ago
